envelope.description: Add the step host: the step.call stream request

body.title: Add the step host: the step.call stream request
body.summary: Register step.call as a stream handler with a table of the seven tools; run the handler under the StepCallContext with the stream's signal; answer with a 'done' frame carrying the envelope unchanged, 'step-unknown-tool' and 'step-failed' error frames. Reword the four moved state stores' miss message to say the daemon was restarted and the run must be started again.
acceptanceChecks: for each of the seven tools, the reply through step.call deep-equals the reply of the handler called directly on the same temporary store
unknown tool and throwing handler give the named error frames; a socket close fires the handler's signal
each state store's miss message names a daemon restart

tests.name: step host: done frame carries the handler's envelope unchanged; unknown tool gives step-unknown-tool; a throwing handler gives step-failed with its message
equivalence: each of the seven tools through step.call returns the same envelope as the handler called directly on the same temporary store
cancellation: closing the stream during a design-review wait and during a code-review wait aborts the inner run in the daemon
state store miss: each of the four stores says the daemon was restarted and the run must be started again
